edits.old: Then a caller holding only RW-RISK is refused with 403 and MSG-P4-002, and one access entry with result "REFUSED" is written
edits.new:
Then a caller holding only RW-RISK is refused with 403 and MSG-P4-002, and one access entry with result "REFUSED" is written

  Scenario: AC7 A request with no session is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the caller holds no session
    When the route asks GET /api/recovery/access/v1/me/session for that caller
    Then the route answers 401 with MSG-P4-001
    Then nothing is read and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC8 An absent date filter is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a caller holding RW-RISK, whose Reporting letter is R
    When it opens the agent monitor with no date filter
    Then the route answers 422 with MSG-GEN-001
    Then no page is answered

  Scenario: AC9 A page bound outside the declared range is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a caller holding RW-RISK, whose Reporting letter is R
    When it asks a page bound outside the declared range
    Then the route answers 422 with MSG-GEN-001
    Then no page is answered and the range is read from a data row

  Scenario: AC10 An event code not in the list in force is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the list in force holds the event codes of the access-event list
    When a caller asks an event code that is not in that list
    Then the route answers 422 with MSG-GEN-001
    Then the filter offers only the values of the list in force

  Scenario: AC11 Unavailable parameters or lists fail closed (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the parameters or the lists read is unavailable
    When the caller of AC1 opens the dashboard
    Then the route answers 503
    Then no filter value and no event code comes from code and no read is served

  Scenario: AC12 A failed decision-record append serves no metric row (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the decision-record append of the access entry fails
    When the caller of AC1 opens the dashboard
    Then the route answers 503 with MSG-P7-003 and no metric row is answered
    Then the read is not served and is not recorded

  Scenario: AC13 A timed-out metric read shows no partial screen (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-agent contract mock times out on the metric read
    When the caller of AC1 opens the dashboard
    Then the route answers 503 for that part of the composite
    Then the answer alone is not shown as the screen and no entry of a partial read is written

  Scenario: AC14 An active break-glass grant is shown and recorded (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a break-glass grant is active for the caller of AC1
    When the caller opens the dashboard
    Then the read is allowed and the access entry carries the grant reference
    Then the MSG-P4-004 banner is shown

  Scenario: AC15 An agent service identity is held to the same role rows (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a service identity of the rwb-agent login (DP-02) holding no Reporting letter
    When it opens the agent monitor
    Then the route answers 403 with MSG-P4-002 naming the action "open the agent monitor"
    Then one access entry is written with area "REPORTING", right "R" and result "REFUSED"
